KISWAHILI — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #5
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: KISWAHILI
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Kuandika 1.3.1 Viakifishi, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Kuandika 1.3.1 Viakifishi.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Kuandika 1.3.1 Viakifishi.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Kuandika 1.3.1 Viakifishi.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Kuandika 1.3.1 Viakifishi.

2. Ni sentensi ipi iliyo sahihi kisarufi? (1 mark)
   A. Mwanafunzi anasoma vitabu mzuri.
   B. Mwanafunzi anasoma kitabu.
   C. Kitabu anasoma mwanafunzi kwa.
   D. Anasoma mwanafunzi kitabu ya.

3. Kinyume cha “refu” ni: (1 mark)
   A. nene
   B. fupi
   C. zito
   D. pana
